svg.text: JetBrains IntelliJ YAML/Helm/Kustomize Code Intelligence + Freelens Cluster Management UI + WASI P2 Sandbox
1. Frontend Workbench & Freelens React UI (TypeScript / React / CodeMirror 6 / xterm.js)
• Static inspections (deprecated APIs, probes) + Quick Fixes
• Live streaming kubectl logs -f in regular Editor Tab
• Live cluster resource YAML in regular Editor Tab
• Top-right Reload, Diff (kubectl diff), Save & Apply (⌘S)
2. OpenIDEA Tauri Host & WASI P2 Component Runtime (crates/ide-host • crates/ide-plugin • wit/plugin@1.3)
• wasmtime WASI P2 sandbox • 8 MiB MAX_VIEW_MESSAGE
• Powers Pod/Node xterm.js TTY & live Editor Tab logs
3. Rust Wasm Plugin Component (plugins/official/kubernetes/src/ → dist/plugin.wasm • wasm32-wasip2)
4. Local Configuration, CLI Tooling & Target Kubernetes Clusters
